code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with relative neutropenia and lymphopenia, and monocytosis with elevated basophils. There is also low total CO₂, suggesting possible metabolic acidosis. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Findings may indicate chronic disease, bone marrow suppression, or infection; clinical correlation is recommended.
